idea-plugin.name: Cron Schedule Lint for crontab, Kubernetes CronJob, GitHub
idea-plugin.description:
Names every schedule line in the file you have open that fires at the wrong hour, twice, or never at all - and prints the next three times each one really fires, in the zone that actually applies.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Cron Schedule Lint for crontab, Kubernetes CronJob, GitHub: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 29 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/cron-schedule-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/cron-schedule-lint

action.text: Cron Schedule Lint for crontab, Kubernetes CronJob, GitHub: Check This File
action.description: Run Cron Schedule Lint for crontab, Kubernetes CronJob, GitHub on the file in the editor
